fact: As of 5 September 2026 Libya has not enacted a binding statute imposing an AI duty; the June 2026 charter and strategy are not numbered laws and create no enforceable duty, and Laws 5 and 6 of 2022 impose no AI-specific duty.
title: Libya: AI, scraping, privacy, cybersecurity, communications, content-moderation, age-gating, and reuse law
